title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode7 No Matter What

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Water Taxi

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess it won't be long until we arrive.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and the others said that they're waiting for us at the terminal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. They sent a message.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, Tenma uses some really interesting stamps.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean the sumo stamps?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Are these crying sumo stamps a series?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Apparently. She's really liking them lately, so she's been using them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But seeing them every day has made them grow on me, so I ended up buying them too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? I didn't realize you have the same ones.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, you two really are close.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're childhood friends and in the same band after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... I guess being in the same group would naturally bring you closer. And even more so if you're childhood friends too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Definitely. But Saki and I weren't always together growing up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... That's right...
Tenma was away for a while due to illness, wasn't she?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, she was staying at a faraway hospital until a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... There was a point when we were apart for a while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was a little anxious back then since we had always been together up until that point. But I believed that Saki would recover in no time and it'd all be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even though I held onto that belief, her recovery ended up taking longer than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure that must've been lonely...
Were you able to keep contact with her during that period?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I went to visit her and we sent messages to each other. However, the time we actually spent together in person was quite short.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There were even times when I felt Saki had become kind of distant.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When she got out of the hospital, I was really worried about what would happen if we couldn't talk the same way we used to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But after I got to see her again, all of those worries went away. Because in the end, it was like nothing had changed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's how we've come to now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki wanted all of us to stick together, and made that happen. Thanks to that, we were able to form a band together and are now closer than ever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... I didn't realize all of that happened.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Tenma and Hoshino are amazing... I can only imagine how much courage it would take to meet a friend you haven't seen in so long.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If things didn't work out, then that friendship would just end right there.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Would I be able to do that? I...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani, look. I can see the terminal getting closer. I think we'll be arriving soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right.
I didn't even notice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me neither. I had so much fun talking with you that time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to learn more about you and your band members. Thank you for telling me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going above and beyond so that you can all be together again... Tenma sure is amazing. But that sounds a lot like her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. She really is a strong person. I know that she had it way harder than me, and yet she was just as cheerful as ever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She still is now, and has lots of friends too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's always been really social. She even started calling you by your first name straight away, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, now that you mention it, she did.
Heeeyyy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heeey! Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speak of the devil...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, she's waving. She sure is peppy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome back, you two!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're back. Sorry for making you all worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha, we were a little surprised, but everything's okay!
I was thinking that was very much like you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said that we got separated, but I think it's fine since it'll only be for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like we'll never see each other again. Once we meet up, let's make the most of the rest of the day and enjoy ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's not like we'll never see each other again, huh... That's true.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's nothing wrong with just...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Being apart for a little while.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm so glad that we were able to meet back up!
Was everything okay after that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, everything was fine.
No one called out to me or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone... I'm truly sorry for all of the trouble today.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Huh? Don't worry about it! If anything, it was pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It was exciting and kind of like we were in a drama!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It so was! Really, it was no trouble at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Besides, while you two were sitting around on the water taxi, we ate some sweets, went shopping and had some fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See, I told you. We had nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's this? You two are like super close now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe, not at all.
More importantly, look at the time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We only have an hour left until we have to meet with the rest of the class in front of the station.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Huh?! You're right! I didn't realize so much time has passed!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There isn't really much we can do within an hour, is there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then why don't we just walk around here?
I mean look, the water is so pretty and quite a backdrop for us teenagers, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Since we're here, let's walk around until we have to go.
